paragraphs: Rabbi Shefatai. (Shefatyah, son of David, [II Samuel 3:4](https://www.sefaria.org/II_Samuel.3.4).) Mentioned in [Megillah 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.32a.7-12), reporting five statements in Rabbi Yochanan's name. One of his statements is also cited in his name in [Soferim 3:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Soferim.3.10).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The biblical Shefatyah is a name comparison. He is the son of David and Avital.

The five statements in Megillah use Shefatyah. Soferim has Shefatai in the parallel on reading and study without melody. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3514&lang=en) also compares the name forms.
